name: jarvis
description: A JARVIS-style voice for Claude Code: say "Hey Jarvis" (or hold push-to-talk) to speak, hear the reply, talk over it to interrupt. Local wake word and speech-to-text, Fish Audio speech, optional webcam hand control for the mouse and windows, and control of your TVs and smart home devices.

fishApiKey.title: Fish Audio API key
fishApiKey.description: Key for Fish Audio text-to-speech (fish.audio, API keys page). Stored in secure storage. Leave empty to use FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY from your settings.json env.

voiceId.title: Fish Audio voice
voiceId.description: The model id of a Fish Audio voice (its reference id). Empty uses Fish Audio's default voice; /jarvis voice <id> overrides it.

fishModel.title: Fish Audio model
fishModel.description: s2.1-pro-free is free under Fish's fair use through 30 Nov 2026, and Fish may use requests to improve its models. s2.1-pro needs prepaid API credit (fish.audio/app/developers). Run /jarvis restart after changing it.

voiceEngine.title: Voice engine
voiceEngine.description: fish speaks with Fish Audio over the internet. local speaks with Chatterbox-Turbo on this computer (install it with /jarvis setup local; best with an NVIDIA GPU). /jarvis engine fish|local switches without opening the settings.

localVoiceClip.title: Local voice clip
localVoiceClip.description: Full path of a clean 10 to 20 second recording (wav or mp3) whose voice the local engine copies. Empty uses Chatterbox's built-in voice. Run /jarvis restart after changing it.

wakeWord.title: Wake word
wakeWord.description: on: Jarvis listens for "Hey Jarvis" on this computer (nothing is recorded or sent before it hears it). jarvis: plain "Jarvis" at the start of what you say works too (English transcription only; it never interrupts a reply; its small model downloads when you switch it on). off: push-to-talk only. /jarvis wake on|jarvis|off switches without opening the settings.

bargeIn.title: Interrupting Jarvis
bargeIn.description: speech: talking while Jarvis speaks stops him and he listens (with speakers too, while echo cancelling is on). wake: only "Hey Jarvis" interrupts (for a noisy room, or if Jarvis still interrupts himself). off: only push-to-talk or /jarvis stop. /jarvis bargein switches it.

echoCancelling.title: Echo cancelling
echoCancelling.description: on: Jarvis takes his own voice out of what the microphone hears, so with speakers he doesn't interrupt or wake himself. off: the microphone is used as it is (try it if your voice sounds cut while Jarvis talks). Run /jarvis restart after changing it.

wakeSensitivity.title: Wake word sensitivity
wakeSensitivity.description: high wakes more easily but also more often by mistake (TV, other people); low needs a clearer "Hey Jarvis". Run /jarvis restart after changing it.

modelRouting.title: Models for voice requests
modelRouting.description: auto: Sonnet answers what you say, so replies start quickly; a quick Haiku check sends complex requests to Opus and the hardest to Fable. Say "use Opus" or "think hard" to choose yourself. off: your session's model answers. Typed messages always use your session's model. /jarvis routing auto|off switches it.

pttKey.title: Push-to-talk key
pttKey.description: Hold this key to talk, release to send. Examples: right ctrl, right alt, f13, caps lock.

sttModel.title: Speech-to-text model
sttModel.description: faster-whisper model. auto picks large-v3-turbo on an NVIDIA GPU and small.en on the CPU. Run /jarvis setup after changing it to download the model.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Language code for speech-to-text, such as en, de or he. English-only models (.en) ignore it.

handControl.title: Hand control
handControl.description: on: Jarvis watches your hands through the webcam and turns gestures into mouse and window actions (install it with /jarvis setup hands). The camera picture never leaves this computer. off: the camera stays off. /jarvis hands on|off switches without opening the settings, until this setting is changed again.

handCamera.title: Hand control camera
handCamera.description: The webcam hand control uses: its number (0 is the first) or part of its name, such as UGREEN. Empty uses the first camera. /jarvis hands camera overrides it.

handEngage.title: Starting hand control
handEngage.description: palm: hold an open palm toward the camera for half a second to take the cursor, so a hand passing by does nothing. always: any hand in view takes it at once (for a projector room). /jarvis hands engage palm|always switches it.
